title: Florida 'Karen' Goes From 0 to 100 After Calling the Cops
description:
A Key West Woman ended up in cuffs after allegedly calling police around 4 a.m. to complain about a parking spot. Police took Michelle Jackson, 26, into custody after she told police a "red Porsche" had been blocking her in, but when the officer noted it wasn’t there, Jackson went on to say it had blocked her in the previous morning. The officer then allegedly informed Jackson to call when her car was being blocked in and went to leave when Jackson allegedly pushed the officer. That’s when this traffic complaint went from zero to 100 in the blink of an eye. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
